healthy.description: Running nodes without alarms, partitions or failing health checks

recvRate.description: Bytes per second from the client

status.description: up, single_active (the active one) or waiting

role.description: Limit the token to this role; defaults to your role

token.description: The token value. It is only shown once.

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

deliver.description: Deliveries to consumers with manual ack

queues.description: The deepest queues (up to 500 inspected), plus any with problems

needsSetup.description: True when no users exist and the first admin can be created with POST /v1/setup

canMonitor.description: The user can see every vhost's objects (administrator or monitoring tag)
